authority_source: meta authority for same-corridor repo-truth path-fence corrections; this is the omitted minimal R4 common binding required to make the landed R5 direct-bootstrap contract functional
classification: minimal R5 bootstrap-authority support closure; not a donor transplant, protected-state schema expansion, cross-platform adapter, or R6 session change

crates/common/src/managed_artifact.rs: publisher_bootstrap_authorization_sha256_v1 only if needed for exact retry
focused inline tests for required, mismatched, non-MAC, unknown-field and canonical-digest behavior
crates/common/src/lib.rs: only the exact re-export of publisher_bootstrap_authorization_sha256_v1 if that helper is implemented
crates/shell/src/execution/mod.rs: only the already-preserved exact re-exports required by substrate-lifecycle-control and substrate-lifecycle-macos
crates/shell/src/lib.rs: only the already-preserved exact R5 re-exports required by the two binaries

common_schema_rules: mac_host_shared requires mac_control_authority and validates it with the already-landed MacPublisherControlAuthorityV1 validator
control authority source_commit/source_tree/source_ref must equal the bootstrap authorization source binding
control authority target_triple must join the exact published control artifact/build record and must not be inferred from the connecting peer
every non-mac_host_shared authorization rejects a present mac_control_authority
the canonical authorization digest includes the control authority field
historical Linux and other non-MAC authorization fixtures remain valid only without the field

protected_state_boundary.rationale: Avoid cross-platform struct-literal churn. Bind exact retry through the existing LifecyclePublisherAnchorV1.request_sha256 authorization digest and the already-existing fixed global System-Keychain MacPublisherControlAuthorityV1 admission account.
protected_state_boundary.required_join: bootstrap must persist or exact-retry the signed scope state and fixed global control-admission account, then verify the account authority source/build/digest against the protected anchor and current authorization before enabling XPC

fd3_runtime_joins: derive the retained requester PID from the kernel-owned AF_UNIX peer credential interface, not serialized input
resolve and hash the retained requester executable and compare it to authorization.mac_control_authority
resolve and hash the running executor image and compare it to authorization.executor_build_evidence
join the invoking controlling terminal/session using kernel process and terminal observations
one canonical request frame and one bounded response frame only; EOF, second frame, mismatch, replacement, cancellation or timeout fails preserving-first
issuer_boundary: The direct control command may derive the authorization only from the exact retained lifecycle capsule, published implementation receipt/build evidence, its current executable identity and the fixed executor identity. No ambient/default project, donor state, caller JSON, reusable authorization file, environment carrier, argv carrier or script output is permitted.

review.discovery: one fresh same-subject three-lens discovery burst or discovery review
review.p3_p4: record only in 06-review-finding-inventory.md; no remediation or review cycle

hard_exclusions: src/bin/substrate-lifecycle-linux.rs, Windows code, Linux/Windows behavior or target commands
donor bulk copy or any donor-only pairing/channel/protected-state prototype beyond the exact field/validator logic named here
new endpoint, transport family, principal, generic selector, reusable authority record, or R6 guest session
native install, code signing, Keychain/XPC/Lima mutation, lifecycle action or evidence
npx gitnexus analyze or tracked context injection
publication: one normal fast-forward R5 commit only after exact MAC-only deterministic proof and terminal review CLEAN
